title: Warehouse and delivery logins can no longer place, re-line, repeat, submit or cancel an order, through the API or through sync upload; reads stay as decided
rootCause:
Finding DOS-115 (QA/findings/10-batch1-regression.md). Architect design: held-review-brief.md:355 removes warehouse and delivery from orders.cancel, setLines, submit and create; reads stay. The founder decision is ALREADY recorded in docs/22: §7 prose :215-216, §8 row :274 and §11 change log :334.

WHY THE CALLS SUCCEED (one cause for both roles; every citation re-read)
1. The matrix admits every member.
   - permissions.ts:518-523 sets orders.create (:518), setLines (:519), repeatLast (:520), submit (:521) and cancel (:523) to ANY_MEMBER.
   - ANY_MEMBER is ALL_ROLES (permissions.ts:13-21 and :39), which includes warehouse and delivery.
   - TenantGuard (tenancy/tenant.guard.ts) looks up the route at :136-141, keyed `${METHOD} ${toNestPattern(path)}` (:282, so `POST /orders/:id/cancel`). It refuses at :178-179 only when `isAllowed` is false.
2. Both services mount orders.
   - warehouse-service: core/src/service/definitions.ts:232 (OrdersModule) and :251 ('orders').
   - delivery-service: definitions.ts:277 and :297.
3. The handler allows the same roles.
   - orders.service.ts:101 sets `ORDER_ROLES = [...STAFF, 'retailer']`.
   - STAFF (platform/authz.ts:6-14) includes warehouse and delivery.
   - `requireRole(ORDER_ROLES)` is called at :142 (create), :155 (setLines), :174 (repeatLast), :235 (submit) and :394 (cancel).
4. The reach check narrows only the rep.
   - `callerReaches` (orders.internals.ts:285-288) is true for any role other than salesperson.
   - So `lockReachableOrder` (orders.service.ts:580-585) passes a warehouse or delivery caller on any order.
   - Staff RLS on sales_orders is tenant-wide on purpose (comment at orders.internals.ts:277-284): warehouse moves order states at pack. The fix belongs in the application layer, not in RLS.

A SECOND DOOR THE DESIGN MISSES (the same capability: draft and re-line)
- `sync.upload` is STAFF (permissions.ts:451), and both services mount SyncModule (definitions.ts:235 and :281).
- `SyncService.upload` has no role check of its own. It takes the handler from `this.registry.get(op.table)` (sync.service.ts:~108-128) and runs `vetoIfStale`, then the handler.
- orders.module.ts:35-36 registers sales_orders and sales_order_lines.
- `applyOrderSync` re-heads an existing draft (orders.sync.ts:59, where `callerReaches` is true for these roles) or inserts a new draft for any shop (:85).
- `applyLineSync` re-lines any draft (:109).
- So after a matrix-only change, POST :3004/sync/upload or :3005/sync/upload could still create and re-line orders.

A THIRD PATH IN THE MATRIX
- orders.repeatLast (orders.service.ts:173-221) creates a draft for any shop through `insertDraft` + `writeLines`. It is order creation by another route.
- docs/23:423-425 already lists it with create, setLines and submit as order writes the warehouse should lose.

DATA FACTS (dos_qa, read-only; order_state_transitions joined to memberships)
- On non-van orders:
  - warehouse: cancel 1 (the probe); plus start_picking 14, pack 8 and dispatch 9 (legitimate, through applyFulfilmentEvent);
  - delivery: cancel 1, submit 1 and confirm 1 (the probes); plus deliver_all 5, deliver_partial 5 and return_undelivered 2 (legitimate).
- Every other delivery submit (123) and confirm (120) is on a source=van_sale order.
- None of the legitimate events passes through the five procedures.

NOTHING LEGITIMATE DEPENDS ON THESE PERMISSIONS
- Van sales: vansales.service.ts:60 checks `requireRole(DOORSTEP)`, then :79-88 calls `insertDraft`, `writeLines` and `submitInTx` directly. delivery.vanSales.create and billing.invoices.issueVanSale are DOORSTEP (permissions.ts:576). `issueVanSale` (billing/invoices.service.ts:752) checks only DOORSTEP, never who created the order.
- AI drafts: drafts.service.ts:149-167 uses the same internal helpers under DRAFT_TAKERS (ai.internals.ts:30-36, which has no warehouse or delivery).
- The only other internal cancel is approvals.service.ts:118 (`cancelInTx`, MANAGEMENT).
- The public methods create, setLines, repeatLast, submit and cancel are called only from orders.controller.ts:19-46.
- Apps:
  - frontend/warehouse-app calls only `orders.get` (app/pack/[orderId].tsx:64);
  - frontend/delivery-app/app/stop/[id]/van-sale.tsx:10-11 says the app never builds a sale from orders.create + submit;
  - only the owner, manager, sales and retailer apps call order writes;
  - no warehouse or delivery nav entry is gated on an order-write permission.
- Offline: sync-tables.ts:80-81 give sales_orders only to SALES and SHOP (plus the desk). The warehouse and delivery manifests never list the table, so no device queue carries it.
